shorts.title: What you will learn: Looping over arrays
shorts.hook: Never start a maximum at zero.
shorts.script: Never start a maximum at zero. Today we walk along an array. We find the biggest value, and we print the array backwards. A for loop with an index lets you read and change items. A range-based for loop is shorter, but it gives only the values. To find the biggest item, keep a variable called best. Compare every item with it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Looping over arrays.

shorts.title: Looping over arrays in one minute
shorts.hook: A for loop with an index lets you read and change items.
shorts.script: A for loop with an index lets you read and change items. A range-based for loop is shorter, but it gives only the values. To find the biggest item, keep a variable called best. Compare every item with it. Think of a teacher who checks every bench in a classroom, one by one. Best starts as the first item, seventy-two. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: LOOPING OVER ARRAYS IN ONE MINUTE
shorts.caption: Looping over arrays in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The loop starts at the last index, four.
shorts.script: The loop starts at the last index, four. It runs while i is zero or more. The step lowers i by one. Each round prints one item. The output is fifty-eight, ninety, sixty-four, eighty-five, seventy-two. The program prints the marks in reverse order. A for loop with an index can read and change items. A range-based for loop gives each value. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A maximum that starts at zero
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. All temperatures are below zero. The program prints zero as the warmest. But zero is not in the array. Best started at zero, and no item beat it. Start best with the first item of the array. Every temperature is below zero, so none is bigger than the starting best of zero. Start with a real item from the array. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: A MAXIMUM THAT STARTS AT ZERO
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A maximum that starts at zero.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: I asked the array who the biggest item is. It said, I will let you compare.
shorts.script: I asked the array who the biggest item is. It said, I will let you compare. Write a loop that finds the smallest mark in an array of five marks. Write your answer in the comments. A for loop with an index can read and change items. A range-based for loop gives each value. Start best with the first item. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
